newsitem.title: USA: ADM milling unit moving to headquarters.
newsitem.headline: ADM milling unit moving to headquarters.

text.p: Archer Daniels Midland Co said Wednesday its ADM Milling Co subsidiary will move its administrative offices from Overland Park, Kan., to its corporate headquarters in Decatur, Ill.
The company said its mills will continue with no change in management or operating style. The laboratory in Olathe, Kan., and the grain group at the Kansas City Board of Trade will remain intact.

"This is a consolidation to better use the resources available from the synergy standpoint, both for ADM Milling and for the other operations of the company," Craig Hamlin, group vice president and president of ADM Milling, said in a statement.
ADM Milling operates 60 facilities in the United States, Mexico, Canada and the Caribbean.
